nodes.name: index.html
nodes.summary: HTML shell template for the React frontend (Create React App), providing the root mount div, manifest/favicon links, and Google Fonts (Inter) preconnect tags into which the bundled JS is injected at build time.
nodes.languageNotes: Standard Create React App public/index.html with %PUBLIC_URL% placeholder substitution during build.

nodes.name: manifest.json
nodes.summary: Web app manifest declaring PWA metadata (app name, icons, theme/background colors, start URL) for when the frontend is installed on a mobile or desktop device.

nodes.name: robots.txt
nodes.summary: Search engine crawler policy allowing all user agents unrestricted access to the site (no paths disallowed).
